findings.finding: The first column of the technical-progress/recovery matrix splits breakthroughs into breakthrough and a standalone s. All text is present but the isolated glyph is an avoidable readability defect in the specifically requested focus area.
findings.requested_fix: Widen the first matrix column or adjust the row-label typography so breakthroughs fits as a whole word; verify the other columns and page flow after rendering.
findings.resolution: Confirmed visually on both final page-3 images after column widths changed to 20%/40%/40%; no isolated character, missing text, clipping or new page-flow defect.

supplementary_checks.note: Number/link check supplements actual inspection of all contents pages; it is not used as a substitute for visual review.

limitations: This is a targeted visual review of the specified full-report pages plus all brief pages, not a visual audit of every one of the 276 full-report pages. Normal paragraph continuation across a page is acceptable when heading and text remain together and nothing is lost.
resolution: All requested visual pages passed after EN-VIS-01 repair. Final PDF hashes verified. Total page counts remain 276 and 9. No source or PDF modified by reviewer; only renders and this independent review record written.

rerender_comparison.method: Re-render each previously reviewed page at the same fitz scale and compare PNG SHA256.
